title: Lead Measurement Analytics
description: New Lead Measurement Analytics Canada - Remote Apply Now Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience. The opportunity At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries. We are proud of: The work we do and the innovation we drive Our values of share, care and dare Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration The role We are looking for a Lead Measurement Analytics professional to shape high-value measurement strategies, establish scalable instrumentation approaches, and elevate the quality and consistency of measurement delivery across client engagements. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will advise internal and client stakeholders on tagging strategy, event design, consent-aware tracking, implementation quality, and measurement governance. You will combine measurement leadership, business advisory skills, and cross-functional influence to connect business goals with robust, privacy-conscious data collection and analytics implementation. You will thrive in this role if you are: A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus) Role responsibilities Lead complex, high-impact measurement strategy, tagging, instrumentation, and implementation initiatives across clients, business areas, and strategic programs. Define measurement strategies that connect business objectives, reporting requirements, experimentation needs, consent requirements, customer event flows, and downstream data usage. Advise internal and client stakeholders on measurement maturity, instrumentation strategy, data-collection design, privacy considerations, and implementation tradeoffs. Establish and refine best practices for measurement plans, event frameworks, naming conventions, parameter structures, data-layer requirements, consent-aware behavior, quality assurance, and implementation documentation. Guide the design of scalable tagging architectures, event instrumentation, validation approaches, and platform configurations. Translate complex or ambiguous stakeholder questions into clear measurement approaches, implementation frameworks, and actionable recommendations. Lead implementation audits and reviews to identify gaps, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve tracking ecosystems. Collaborate across analytics, data science, engineering, platform, experimentation, and reporting teams to strengthen end-to-end measurement. Review major measurement programs and deliverables for quality, clarity, consistency, consent alignment, and business value. Contribute measurement expertise to solution shaping, proposals, thought leadership, and new-business opportunities. Create and improve reusable frameworks, standards, templates, quality-assurance assets, and accelerators. Promote strong expectations for governance, privacy, consent, and implementation standards. Mentor practitioners and help define excellent measurement practice across the organization. Must have qualifications To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications: Deep expertise in digital measurement, event tracking, tagging strategy, consent-aware instrumentation, and analytics implementation. Experience shaping measurement approaches in complex, ambiguous, and highly visible business environments. The ability to connect implementation design, business context, privacy requirements, and downstream analytics needs. Strong knowledge of tag management, data layers, consent behavior, cookie governance, customer event flows, and implementation-quality standards. Strong stakeholder-management and advisory skills, including the ability to communicate with senior audiences. Systems thinking across measurement, analytics, experimentation, platforms, and reporting workflows. The ability to improve quality and consistency across multiple teams through collaboration and influence. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including workshop facilitation, presentations, and strategic advisory communication. The ability to balance strategic thinking with practical delivery considerations. Experience collaborating with distributed, multidisciplinary teams. AI fluency You actively use approved AI-enabled tools and workflows to improve measurement documentation, tracking-plan quality, quality-assurance preparation, implementation reviews, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication. You understand that AI-generated tagging logic, documentation, and implementation guidance require human review. You validate outputs against platform behavior, data-layer realities, consent requirements, governance standards, and client-specific measurement needs. You also help strengthen responsible AI adoption by contributing reusable methods, coaching approaches, quality controls, and delivery standards that improve client value without compromising implementation rigor, privacy, or accountability. This reflects the three AI expectations in the source: hands-on adoption, human validation, and leadership of responsible team practices. Tools and platforms You may work with technologies such as: Analytics Google Analytics 4 Adobe Analytics Amplitude Other analytics platforms relevant to the client environment CDP Platforms Bloomreach Treasure Data Adobe RT Optimizely Data Platform Tag management and implementation Google Tag Manager Adobe Launch Tealium iQ Other relevant tag-management platforms Consent and privacy management OneTrust TrustArc Osano Usercentrics Other relevant consent-management platforms Quality assurance and validation Browser developer tools Tag Assistant Adobe Experience Platform Debugger ObservePoint Other measurement debugging and validation tools You may also support measurement design, event instrumentation, consent-aware data collection, and implementation quality in environments that use customer data or event-collection platforms. Broader CDP strategy, activation planning, audience use cases, and personalization strategy sit with the appropriate martech specialists. Nice to have qualifications Google Analytics certification or equivalent GA4 training Google Tag Manager training or equivalent coursework Adobe Analytics training Adobe Launch or related implementation training Privacy, consent, or analytics implementation training Relevant training across analytics, customer data, consent-management, or implementation platforms If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn. The benefits This is a Full time position based in Canada. The offered salary range is $110,000 CAD - $160,000 CAD annually, depending on experience and location. Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer: Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent) Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process. Your application process Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses. We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know. About Valtech Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world. At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more. At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.
